ns2:course.label: Independent Study
ns2:course.description: Independent projects and/or research in any phase of health, kinesiology, physical education, and related areas selected by the students. May be repeated in separate semesters to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Junior or senior standing; grade-point average of 2.5; consent of instructor.
